text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: billing pipeline anomaly detected for region EU-1. Token-count divergence + delayed ingest observed. Several overage flags triggered (~12 customers). Incident ID INC-2026-3245. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/billing-anomaly

sre-oncall: ack. paging @billing-eng @data-eng. oncall taking lead. any immediate customer-facing impact known?

cs-lead: seeing 6 inbound tickets mentioning surprise overages. customers ask for confirmation. will hold comms until we have triage details. :eyes:

billing-eng: running quick metrics. aggregate token emit for eu1 window shows +220% vs baseline at 15:00 UTC. suspect duplicate/replay from emitter. running sample query now.

data-eng: quick query run:
```sql
SELECT region, count(*) as cnt, min(ts) as start, max(ts) as end
FROM usage_events
WHERE region = 'eu1' AND ts >= '2026-08-12T14:50:00Z'
GROUP BY region;
-- result: region=eu1 cnt=1,342,112 start=2026-08-12T14:50:01Z end=2026-08-12T15:04:12Z
```

infra-eng: no infra deploys in last hour. kafka metrics show broker spike and consumer lag anomalies at ~15:02 UTC. offsets indicate a transient replay window on topic `usage-eu1`. preparing to throttle consumer group.

billing-eng: confirmed duplicate message_id pattern in sample logs (message_id repeated across batches). triage plan: 1) pause eu1 consumer group, 2) run dedupe on ingested partitions, 3) apply deduped backfill to ledger and reconcile, 4) suppress overage alerts while we reconcile. executing step 1 now.

sre-oncall: pausing consumer group eu1-bill-consumers... done. consumers paused at 15:06 UTC.

incident-bot: action logged: consumer group `eu1-bill-consumers` paused by @sre-oncall at 15:06 UTC. telemetry note: ingest lag expected ~2-5m.

data-eng: spinning up dedupe job on affected partitions (shard 3 first). sample log:
```
[15:12:03] partition=3 duplicates=1.92x sample_size=100k
[15:18:25] partition=3 dedupe_pass=complete, net_inflation=+92,213 tokens
```
ETA full dedupe ~30m for all partitions. preparing delta snapshot for cs.

cs-lead: can we get list of customers who saw overage flags? need to prioritize outreach and propose credits if false positives.

billing-eng: pulling list now. top impacted (prelim): acme-corp, finly, medtools, papertrail. sending CSV to #secure-ops. recommend temporary alert suppression and provisional credits until reconcile completes.

platform-pm: recommend suppressing customer overage notification emails and posting a brief "we're investigating" notice. coordinate with legal/comms if credits > $5k.

cs-lead: posting soft comms: "We're investigating unexpected usage spikes in EU region; this may lead to false overage notifications. No action required from you at this time. We'll update by end of hour." sending.

sre-oncall: dedupe pass for shard 3 finished at 15:22. early delta: net +0.18% tokens after dedupe (i.e., events were inflated). rolling remaining shards.

billing-eng: applied patch to ledger for processed shards. reconciliation trending toward baseline. monitor shows token emit returning to normal. recommendation: keep billing suppression ON until full backfill done.

incident-bot: note: severity updated to P2. no SLA breach at this time. timeline being recorded under INC-2026-3245.

cs-lead: once final deltas are visible I'll approve customer credits. what's ETA for final reconciliation?

data-eng: full dedupe + backfill predicted complete by 15:45 UTC. final delta expected <0.5% org-wide. will upload CSV of deltas + reconciliation script output to the incident folder.

sre-oncall: resuming consumers at 15:40 UTC. monitoring: token emit stabilized to baseline within 2 minutes post-resume.

billing-eng: final reconcile applied. sample for acme-corp: reported spike removed, final token delta -0.03% (i.e., negligible). recommending no invoice changes; propose automated credit of $0.00 for small deltas, manual credits queued for any >$100 discrepancies.

cs-lead: approving proposed credit workflow. will reach out proactively to the 3 largest impacted customers with apology + summary.

incident-bot: incident marked RESOLVED at 15:46 UTC pending postmortem. postmortem owner(s): @billing-eng, @data-eng. follow-ups: add emitter-side dedupe, improve kafka replay detection alerts, add automated suppression rules for short-lived replay spikes.

sre-oncall: closing live thread. I'll open a follow-up PR to the runbook with exact commands used. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
